'''Obus VI''' was an aquatic [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] that was located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was uncharted before the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. It was picked by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] as the location of his new multi-part base of operations - [[The Coil (Obus VI)|the Coil]] - for its proximity to [[Zakuul]]. After the construction was completed, the base consisted of underwater section, an underground section beneath that, and a [[space elevator]] linking the facility to an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid base|base]]. Obus VI was surrounded by the strongest scrambling field [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] could buy. The field prevented any unauthorized communications, leaving the entire planetoid undetectable. The entire complex was [[Escape from the Coil|destroyed]] in [[3630 BBY]] when the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-55]] made his escape from the base.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obus VI appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.
